title: Recover unpromoted stale initial proposals through one owner CLI continuation
body:
## One causal atom: safely retire an unpromoted initial-admission proposal

User requests a real Noodle order and a closed Issue atom that makes the P-class / CLI shortest continuation executable. Soodles #39 and #44 remain separate delivery atoms; do not fold their code, experiments or closure into this owner repair.

### Trigger and current source
At main `656e9ec73689c523058750e8b0a2388a15bb84fa`, initial admission rejects a stale revision or inconsistent completed-order projection and preserves `orders-next.json`, but no supported retirement continuation exists. Soodles' preserved proposal revision is `970e887025e1afec651ffdd8f8b42f76`; canonical revision is `dfb96fcf7d8d776ea177173c4c0c717d`. No Issue39 admission effect/worker exists. [Immutable failure evidence](https://github.com/ed3c/soodles/tree/2c78b9151af96e3f6e6f52d9f0836a89942bb8da/docs/experiments/agent-context/delivery-blocked).

### Owned correction and write boundary
Noodle owns one stopped-owner inspection/retirement entry for a definitively unpromoted rejected initial proposal. Reuse the existing instance lock, canonical-state readback, order parser, effect identity and process/session observation. Bind exact proposal digest and current canonical revision; preserve original bytes and refusal reason durably; unknown or admitted execution must remain refused. Inspect the completed-order projection mismatch in the same admission boundary and correct its producer/consumer only if the nearest discriminating control proves the causal defect; never weaken duplicate/admission guards.

Allowed production boundary: root CLI registration and the new admission CLI file, `cmdmeta/` and `generate/` producers for the existing generated Noodle skill; `loop/` admission/recovery and nearest tests; existing `internal/lockfile`, canonical-state or process helpers only if the shared owner boundary requires them; the existing Noodle P-class skill and a bounded recovery recipe; narrowly related `brain/codebase` note and `docs/evidence/initial-admission-recovery` receipts. Existing tests may be corrected with the faulty implementation. No provider authority changes, credential broker, second scheduler, generic retry framework, manual snapshot/effect edits, or fabricated order completion.

### Observable behavior
- One inspection entry returns structured owner, status, exact subject/revision, refusal reason, and supported `next` / exact operation inputs. The Session does not guess identity, permissions, state or recovery commands.
- A retirement requires unchanged input and exclusive owner access. Reject active loop/session, owned or admission-ledger subject, mismatched digest/revision and unreadable/ambiguous state. Preserve checkpoint, canonical ledger and evidence on every refusal.
- Persist attributable retirement intent/evidence before removing the mailbox. Actual process interruption before/after the persistence boundary resumes by owner readback with no second dispatch and without overwriting a later proposal.
- After retirement, return fresh canonical-readback/admission guidance. Retirement does not admit, restart or complete an order and cannot authorize provider writes.

### N / P / L / R
N: this specification and reports. P: the shortest existing-entry recipe and recorded Session consumption. L: subject-bound gates, durable retirement/recovery, admission and quiescence checks. R: exact provider CI, merge and closure readbacks for this Noodle Issue. A green CLI or test cannot supply missing execution or provider truth.

### Acceptance and actual order
Register this Issue as a real Noodle order before its implementation writer starts, with measured local Codex carrier and native session/tool/Agent-produced typed outcome; no post-hoc empty order. Existing Noodle source control root is independent of the preserved Soodles production root. Use bounded observation and preserve actual child exits; missing outcomes remain incomplete.

For every new gate preserve defect RED, the same control corrected GREEN, and legal non-case GREEN. Reuse initial_admission_test.go controls; add actual child-process fault controls and exercise preserved A-completed → stale B input. A correct refusal is GREEN. Freeze external control/observer selection before final acceptance. Run `pnpm check` and exact-head provider Test under the repository contract; no disabled tests. Demonstrate a fresh Session consuming the CLI continuation without reconstructing argv or checkpoint and report actual actions, without claiming statistically proven cost reduction.

### Delivery and cleanup
A supervised handoff preserves the original Noodle order/worktree identity and candidate commit. Read back exact-head checks, provider merge and Issue closure, then Noodle-owned completion/reconciliation and worktree cleanup; only then report this atom resolved. Do not use Soodles' hardcoded landing implementation to authorize a different repository. Preserve unknown writes and never replay them from memory. If the existing Noodle delivery entry cannot represent the requested order lifecycle, expose that concrete boundary rather than forging completion.

The repaired, independently accepted owner may then be explicitly pinned to inspect and recover the preserved Soodles proposal, retaining before/after receipts. That proves recovery only; Soodles #44 and #39 still require their own admissions and delivery receipts.

### Observed verification-boundary correction (2026-09-17)
The full `pnpm check` passed. The required smoke harness hardcodes `gpt-5.3-codex-spark`, which this actual ChatGPT carrier rejects before execution; its UI active-worktree control consequently times out. Preserve that failed run. Within this same acceptance boundary, permit the narrow model selection in `e2e/helpers_test.go` and `e2e/smoke_test.go` to use the already measured `gpt-6-astra` carrier, and rerun the unchanged behavioral controls. No skipped tests, relaxed UI assertions, new provider policy, or fabricated Agent results.

A second real same-order attempt also exposed that baseline retry dispatch preserves the worktree path but runs `git checkout`/`git clean` on uncommitted progress. Both blocked attempts and source restoration evidence are retained. Do not requeue uncommitted work again. Finish and verify the candidate in the original worktree, persist a passing commit, then use the existing same-order continuation for independent completion verification; do not claim dirty-worktree recovery is fixed by this atom.

The user separately authorized an independent `verify-noodle` feature map in Soodles using pinned pstack create/maintain, referenced by its existing execute skill. That consumer has a separate repository/delivery boundary; its completion is not implied by this Noodle repair.
